announcements.headline: Ecovelex 2026 Approval in Italy
announcements.insight: Italian regulatory approval for Ecovelex marks a critical de-risking milestone for Eden Research's commercialisation strategy in the EU, validating its proprietary biodegradable polymer technology ahead of the 2026 timeline. This reduces execution risk significantly but does not yet translate to immediate revenue, keeping it in the 'notable development' rather than 'transformative' category.
